span.p:
Collection: patch_memory
- patch_id, job_id
- exception_type, message
- category, repair_strategy
- diff_applied (document)
- outcome
- embedding: sentence-transformers
all-MiniLM-L6-v2
- query: top-K=3, where=category

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Collection: architecture_memory
- decision_id, job_id
- modality, task_type
- num_rows, imbalance_ratio
- model_selected
- imbalance_strategy
- outcome_metric, outcome_label
- embedding: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
- query: top-K=3, where=modality+task

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Collection: tool_memory
- tool_id, agent_name
- tool_name, docstring
- source_file
- embedding: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
- query: top-K=5, semantic search
